If reference_id is omitted one is generated and returned. The response is always the deposit identifiers, never a fee preview.

paymentMethod.description: How the customer pays at the checkout: CARD or PAYBYBANK

How the customer pays. PAYBYBANK: pay by bank (a hosted checkout, or bank transfer details for KES and NGN). CARD: hosted card checkout. CAPITECPAY: Capitec Pay for South African customers, requires idNumber. USSD: bank USSD dial code (NGN), requires institution.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where the wallet is used. Optional when it can be derived from the currency.

referenceId.description: Your own unique reference for this payment. Must not have been used before.

idNumber.description: Customer national ID number (required for Capitec Pay in South Africa - 13 digit SA ID)

institution.description: Customer's bank. Required when paymentMethod is USSD, because the dial code is issued by one specific bank. Pass a value verbatim from GET /deposit/bank/checkout/institutions; a bank is identified by name, not by a numeric code. Ignored for other payment methods.

forceDefaultMethod.description: Show only the chosen paymentMethod to the customer, where the provider supports it.

name.description: Account holder name. Optional: when omitted, the name registered on the destination account is resolved from the bank and used instead, and is returned on the withdrawal status. Required for corridors where a bank name enquiry is not available (e.g. South Africa).

address.example: Unit 163 Richmond Street, 25 Allan Road, Oakdene, 4250
